field.label: Enable
field.help: Start the Cloudflare Tunnel service and include it in the generated runtime configuration when you apply changes.

field.label: Mode
field.help: Token mode uses a Cloudflare-managed tunnel token from Zero Trust and ignores local ingress rules. Config File mode writes a local cloudflared config file and uses the ingress rules from the Ingress Rules tab.

field.label: Tunnel Token
field.help: Paste the tunnel token from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard. This is only required in Token mode and is written to the local token file on apply.

field.label: Tunnel Name
field.help: Friendly name for the tunnel. In Config File mode this becomes the tunnel name written into the generated cloudflared config.

field.label: Post-Quantum
field.help: Enable Cloudflare's post-quantum option for tunnel connections. Leave this enabled unless you need to troubleshoot compatibility with an older environment.

field.label: Edge IP Version
field.help: Choose whether cloudflared should prefer IPv4, prefer IPv6, or let Cloudflare decide automatically when connecting to the edge.

field.label: Protocol
field.help: Choose the transport protocol used between cloudflared and the Cloudflare edge. Auto is usually the best default.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Set the verbosity written to the cloudflared log file. Use Info for normal operation and Debug only when gathering troubleshooting data.
